evals.name: new-floating-player-bars
evals.prompt: I play Dark Age of Camelot on the live servers (1.129) with the plain stock Atlantis UI, no custom UI installed yet. I want a small floating window that shows my own health, endurance and power as three horizontal bars with the percentage as a number next to each bar, plus two little buttons for /stick and /face. Please give me every file I need, tell me exactly where each file goes under the game folder and how to open the window in game. Write the files into the outputs folder I gave you.
evals.expected_output: A customN_window.xml whose WindowTemplate Name is customN_window (N in 0..19), bound to summary_player_hits / summary_player_end / summary_player_power with StatusBarDef + ScalarLabelDef, buttons firing Stick and Face, a toggle button firing ToggleCustomN added to a copied stock window (or an included file), an <Include> for the new file placed in a file the user overrides, install steps (ui\custom, Custom skin at character select), no edits to uimain.xml, and no instruction to create a bare assets.xml from scratch.
assertions: An output XML defines a WindowTemplate whose Name is customN_window with N between 0 and 19
The XML binds all three player percentage adapters summary_player_hits, summary_player_end and summary_player_power (exact case)
Bars use StatusBarDef and the numbers use ScalarLabelDef (at least 3 of each)
Buttons fire the Stick and Face events via OnClickEvent
A toggle button fires ToggleCustomN with the same N as the window template name
The new window file is loaded via an <Include> and the answer never instructs editing uimain.xml
Install steps say to put files in ui\custom and to select the Custom skin at character select
Does not create a from-scratch assets.xml that would replace the stock one (or explicitly says to copy the stock atlantis/assets.xml first)
Every XML file written to outputs parses as well-formed XML

evals.name: debug-button-does-nothing
evals.prompt: My DAoC custom UI is in E:\games\daoc\ui\custom. I added a 'Custom' button to my command_window.xml that is supposed to open my custom3 window (custom3_window.xml exists, it is included from my assets.xml, and the window template inside is named custom3_window). The button draws fine but clicking it does absolutely nothing. The file is attached as inputs/command_window.xml. What is wrong and what exactly do I change?
evals.expected_output: Finds both planted bugs: (1) the InvisibleButtonDef listed after the new button covers it and swallows clicks because controls receive input in XML order, so move the button after it or shrink the invisible button; (2) the event is ToggleCustom4 but the window is custom3_window, so it must be ToggleCustom3. Does not blame uimain.xml or suggest reinstalling.
assertions: Identifies that the button's event ToggleCustom4 does not match the custom3_window and must be ToggleCustom3
Identifies that the InvisibleButtonDef listed after the button covers it and intercepts the click (input follows XML order)
Corrected command_window.xml fires ToggleCustom3 and no longer contains ToggleCustom4
In the corrected file, no InvisibleButtonDef that comes after the Custom button covers its position
Corrected file parses and keeps all eight original buttons (Stick, Face, Follow, Sprint, Sit, Map, Journal, Custom)
Does not blame uimain.xml or recommend reinstalling

evals.name: triage-logic-request
evals.prompt: For Dark Age of Camelot (Eden server) I want to mod my UI so that my group members' buff icons show a countdown timer in seconds on each icon, and the member's health bar turns bright red and flashes when they drop under 25%. Can you write the XML for that? I'm comfortable editing files in ui\custom.
evals.expected_output: Explains clearly that the XML UI system cannot do logic (no timers, no conditionals, no computed colours): it can only bind controls to existing adapters and fire existing events. Points to daochook (Lua/ImGui client hook) as the route for countdowns and conditional colouring, with the caveat about server rules. Offers what XML CAN do instead (group buff icons via the existing group_buffs/concentration windows, group_health0-7 bars with digital readouts, con colour via group_color adapters). Does not invent fake XML attributes such as thresholds, conditions or timers.
assertions: States that the DAoC XML UI cannot implement countdown timers or conditional (threshold-based) colouring
Names daochook as the way to get Lua/ImGui logic in the client
Does not present fabricated XML elements for logic (Threshold, Condition, Timer, Countdown, Flash, Blink, If, When, Script...)
Offers a real XML alternative using existing adapters (group_health0-7 bars/readouts, group buff icons, group_color)
Mentions that daochook is a client modification and that server rules should be checked

evals.name: debug-blank-window-subtle-faults
evals.prompt: I made a little vitals window for DAoC (live, stock Atlantis base) in ui\custom\custom2_window.xml, included from my copy of assets.xml, with a ToggleCustom2 button that works (the window opens and I can drag it). But the window is just the frame: no name, no bars, no numbers show up. Attached as inputs/custom2_window.xml. Please find everything that is wrong and give me the fixed file.
evals.expected_output: Finds the background FullResizeImageDef listed last (covers everything; must be first), the adapter case error Summary_Player_Hits (adapters are case sensitive), the template-name typo blue_statu (undefined, bar never renders) and ideally MinWidth 4 being below the 9-slice cap size for a resizable window. Uses or recommends the linter. Returns a corrected file with the background first and names fixed, without inventing new adapters.
assertions: Identifies that the background FullResizeImageDef is listed last and covers the other controls (draw order)
Identifies the adapter case error Summary_Player_Hits -> summary_player_hits
Identifies the misspelled status bar template (statusbar_blu / blue_statu) as undefined
Mentions MinWidth 4 is too small for a resizable window with a 9-slice background
Corrected file parses, has the background as the first def, uses summary_player_hits and a plausible template name
Uses or recommends scripts/daoc_ui_lint.py
